summary: Amber International Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, announcing the appointment of Prouden HK Limited as its new independent registered public accounting firm, replacing WWC, P.C., effective the same date. The change was approved by the audit committee. WWC's audit reports for fiscal years 2024 and 2025 contained no adverse opinions or disclaimers, except for an adverse opinion on internal control over financial reporting for 2025 due to material weaknesses. No disagreements or reportable events occurred during the relevant periods. This is a routine auditor change, not a special situation such as a going-private or strategic review.
